note: Expected outcomes written from airport and airline sources and general airline practice, independent of the engine's output. Each case stays 'reviewed: false' until a person has checked it. profile-list-zh is product-specific and not in the gold set. Changes after the first comparison run are listed in 'changes' with their reasons; they correct the gold set itself and were not made to favour any mode.

outcomes.workable: fine to go ahead, enough time
outcomes.tight: says it can work, with little slack
outcomes.not_workable: advises against booking it, or says it will probably not work (even if it adds that it might be possible)
outcomes.uncertain: says it cannot be judged reliably without more data
outcomes.ask: asks for missing information instead of judging

changes.change: allow tight and not_workable as well as ranking
changes.reason: The questions ask whether one itinerary works, not which option to pick; 'ranking' alone was the wrong label set.
Decided by the maintainer: a sub-MCT connection that is already booked on one ticket is protected, so 'tight' plus the required MCT point is a fair answer.

changes.change: sharper definitions of tight and not_workable
changes.reason: Answers saying 'very tight, probably not enough, choose a longer connection' were labelled inconsistently; advising against booking now counts as not_workable.
